default_host.label: Default Host
default_host.character_identity: A confident, approachable male podcast host in his early thirties
default_host.appearance: Medium build, light stubble, warm brown eyes, natural skin tone
default_host.clothing: a plain dark charcoal crew-neck t-shirt under an open black overshirt
default_host.hairstyle: short textured dark brown hair, neatly styled
default_host.general_expression: Engaged and friendly, with occasional smiles and raised eyebrows when emphasising a point
default_host.camera_framing: Medium shot, chest-up, centred in frame with headroom
default_host.lighting: Soft key light from the front-left with a subtle rim light, professional podcast lighting
default_host.background_style: Clean modern studio with a dark, slightly out-of-focus background and a faint accent light
default_host.presenter_prompt: Speaking to the camera as a podcast host explaining an idea clearly and energetically
default_host.personality: engaged, direct, occasionally playful, respects the viewer's time

trading_host.label: Trading Host
trading_host.character_identity: A sharp, analytical male trading commentator in his mid thirties
trading_host.appearance: Lean build, clean shaven, focused grey-blue eyes
trading_host.general_expression: Calm and precise, confident, occasional knowing half-smile
trading_host.camera_framing: Medium shot, chest-up, slightly off-centre to the left
trading_host.lighting: Cool key light with monitor glow as fill
trading_host.background_style: Dimly lit trading desk with softly glowing charts on out-of-focus monitors
trading_host.presenter_prompt: Explaining a market concept to the camera like an experienced trader breaking down a chart
trading_host.personality: calm, precise, quietly confident, never hypes

news_host.label: News Host
news_host.character_identity: A polished, credible male news anchor in his late thirties
news_host.appearance: Broad shoulders, clean shaven, attentive dark eyes
news_host.clothing: a dark blue blazer over a white shirt, no tie
news_host.general_expression: Composed and authoritative with measured emphasis
news_host.camera_framing: Medium shot, chest-up, centred, anchor-desk framing
news_host.background_style: Modern newsroom backdrop with blurred screens and a red-and-blue accent
news_host.presenter_prompt: Delivering a news update straight to camera with clear diction

educational_host.label: Educational Host
educational_host.character_identity: A warm, patient male educator in his early forties
educational_host.appearance: Average build, short beard, kind hazel eyes, glasses
educational_host.general_expression: Encouraging and clear, nods when making a point, frequent gentle smiles
educational_host.camera_framing: Medium shot, chest-up, centred with generous headroom
educational_host.lighting: Warm natural-looking key light, soft fill
educational_host.background_style: Bright minimal room with a light wall and a plant slightly out of focus
educational_host.presenter_prompt: Teaching a concept step by step to the camera like a friendly instructor
educational_host.personality: warm, patient, encouraging, explains step by step
